item.title: Alex Kelloff talks to WesternSlopeNow about congressional run
item.description: Alex Kelloff, a Democratic candidate with a 30-year business career, is running for Colorado’s 3rd Congressional District seat currently held by incumbent Jeff Hurd. Kelloff cited concerns regarding the country's current direction and a lack of rural representation as his primary motivations for seeking office.

item.title: CAF hosted their TBM Rides Day to the Grand Valley
item.description: The Commemorative Air Force Rocky Mountain Wing hosted its TBM Rides Day on Saturday morning, offering community members the chance to fly in a historical TBM Avenger. The event took place in the Grand Valley and allowed participants to view the area from the air.

item.title: UPDATE: GJPD seeking information on motorcyclist who fled from officers
item.description: The Grand Junction Police Department is seeking community assistance in identifying a motorcyclist who reportedly fled from officers during a traffic stop.

item.title: Two-vehicle collision on Douglas Pass results in fatalities
item.description: Colorado State Patrol confirmed that two people were killed and one was injured in a two-vehicle crash that occurred on Douglas Pass Saturday night.

item.title: Ex-Caprock employee gets no jail time in child exploitation case
item.description: Shane Chatfield, a former Caprock Academy employee who was arrested on charges of child sexual exploitation, was sentenced to five years of probation on Tuesday.
